card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (1 to 5, or 0) inside a number in a dose, volume or ratio, often the first digit or one before more digits. It is strongest when the number is followed by units such as mg, mL or g.

modes.label: Count of injections or doses
modes.description: A digit giving how many injections or doses are given.

modes.label: Digit in a quantity or ratio
modes.description: A digit that starts or sits inside an amount in mL, g, hours or a mixing ratio.

card.writes: It suppresses digit tokens and a space, so it seems to discourage another digit from coming next.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a dose or volume number, like the 3 in 3 injections.
